units.source_text: 小公子薰君在乳母那里睡觉，此刻醒了，匍匐出室，来拉住源氏的衣袖，那样子非常可爱。

en.t: The young lord Kaoru had been sleeping with his nurse, but now he woke, crawled out of the room, and came to tug at Genji's sleeve, looking utterly adorable.

units.source_text: 他身穿一件白罗上衣，外加一件蔓草纹样的红面紫里的小衫，

en.t: He wore a white gauze upper robe, with a small jacket over it patterned with trailing vines, red on the outside and purple within,

units.source_text: 那长长的衣裾随随便便地拖曳着，胸前几乎全部露出，那衣服都挤在后面。

en.t: and its long skirts dragged carelessly along, while his chest was almost entirely exposed and the clothes had all bunched up behind him.

units.source_text: 这原是小孩的常态，然而此儿的样子特别可爱，

en.t: This was simply how small children often looked, yet this child's appearance was especially lovely,

units.source_text: 肤色白皙，身材苗条，宛似一个柳木削成的人像。

en.t: with fair skin and a slender figure, like a little image carved from willow wood.

units.source_text: 头发好像是特地用鸭跖草汁染过似的油亮，

en.t: His hair shone so glossily that it seemed to have been deliberately dyed with dayflower juice,

units.source_text: 嘴角红润，眉目清秀，教人一看就想起柏木。

en.t: his lips were rosy, and his brows and eyes were finely shaped, so that anyone who saw him at once thought of Kashiwagi.

units.source_text: 柏木的相貌还没有这么艳丽呢，不知他怎么会长得这样漂亮。

en.t: Even Kashiwagi's own looks had not been this radiant, and one could only wonder how the child had grown so beautiful.
Nor did he resemble his mother.

units.source_text: 这一点儿年纪，神情就如此高贵堂皇，迥异常人，

en.t: At such a young age, his expression was already so noble and dignified, so utterly unlike ordinary people,

units.source_text: 源氏觉得比起他自己映在镜中的面影来，并无不如之处呢。

en.t: that Genji felt the boy was in no way inferior even to the image of himself reflected in the mirror.
